title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 AUG)
summary: A collection of feature improvement ideas for Dynamics 365 Business Central submitted by users across multiple areas including agents, development, financial management, inventory, and localization. The post organizes suggestions for enhancements spanning August 2026.
key_points: Multiple feature requests across copilot/agents, data migrations, and development tools
Financial management improvements include fixed payment tolerance, bonus depreciation, and VAT validation
Inventory and manufacturing enhancements covering item tracking, safety stock calculations, and variant management
Development-focused ideas for AL extensions, performance optimization, and new functions
General system improvements for job queues, workflow approvals, and multi-company security

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central?
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the purpose of the post as soliciting community feedback on potential system enhancements

quotes.text: Here is a list of some of them.
